subject: general
question: Atlas mountain range lies in which of the following continents?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atlas Mountains, chain of mountain ranges in northwestern Africa**, running normally southwest to northeast to form the geologic spine of the countries of the Maghrib **(****The western region of the Arab world)—****Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. **
 
• The Atlas Mountain system takes the shape of an** ****increased oblong, enclosing within its ranges an extensive complex of plains and plateaus.**** **
 
• The periodic nature of the rains,** which fall in torrents,** determines the features of drainage in the Atlas.
 
• The Tell Atlas and the **Saharan Atlas merge in the west into the long folds of the ****Middle** Atlas and in the east connect jointly in the Tébessa and Medjerda mountains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mount Elbrus** is the highest mountain in Europe.
 
• **Denali** in Alaska is the highest mountain peak of North America.
 
• **Mount Everest** is a peak in the Himalaya mountain range. 
 
• It is located **between Nepal and Tibet, an autonomous region of China.**​__
